{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the response rate by sex
response_by_sex = trial_df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()
print("Response rate by sex:")
print(response_by_sex)

# Check the response rate by arm
response_by_arm = trial_df.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()
print("\nResponse rate by arm:")
print(response_by_arm)

# Check the distribution of severity by sex
severity_by_sex = pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['severity'])
print("\nSeverity distribution by sex:")
print(severity_by_sex)

# Check the distribution of severity by arm
severity_by_arm = pd.crosstab(trial_df['arm'], trial_df['severity'])
print("\nSeverity distribution by arm:")
print(severity_by_arm)

# Check if sex and arm are balanced across severity
severity_sex_arm = pd.crosstab([trial_df['sex'], trial_df['arm']], trial_df['severity'])
print("\nSeverity distribution by sex and arm:")
print(severity_sex_arm)"}
